newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 FALLS TO 25.457 BLN STG IN WEEK TO JULY 30.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 FALLS TO 25.457 BLN STG IN WEEK TO JULY 30.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.457 billion stg in the week to July 30 from 25.501 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.849 billion stg from 25.810 billion.

Notes and coins in circulation were slightly higher at 25.388 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.335 billion the week before and rose to 25.780 billion from 25.644 billion stg on an unadjusted basis. -- London Newsroom 44 171 542 7715
